title: Evaluation of lung function imaging biomarkers from MRI during the convalescent phase of COVID-19 infection in a monocentric cohort
summary: The purpose of this research project is to evaluate the suitability of MRI for the assessment of pulmonary pathology in patients* with Long-COVID.

interventions.name:
Retrospective analysis of data NAPKON HAP data to LMU Klinikum München in already anonymized form.
